idea-plugin.name: PCI DSS 6.4.3 Payment Page Script Inventory Auditor
idea-plugin.description:
Lists every script on your checkout page that has no integrity hash, no authorisation and no written justification - the three things PCI DSS 6.4.3 has required since 31 March 2025.

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → PCI DSS 6.4.3 Payment Page Script Inventory Auditor: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 22 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/payment-page-script-audit (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/payment-page-script-audit
